column1: # NESTED QUANTIFIERS COST LINEAR TIME. `(a+)+$` against 29 a-characters
# and a `!` takes 45 SECONDS in a backtracking engine and doubles with
# each a-character more. The matcher never backtracks: it steps every
# live thread over each code point once, so a match costs at most the
# text's length times the program's, and the first row runs the shape
# over a hundred a-characters at once (docs/trust.md clause 2).
# Groups nest at most 256 deep, so the parser's recursion stays inside
# either port's stack: a deeper group is refused rather than exhausting it.

# THE PROGRAM BOUND. Counted repetition copies its operand, so the bound
